description: This file provides formatting utility functions for various data types such as duration, timestamps, text truncation, list formatting, numerical parsing, and cost/tokens/percentage formatting. It also re-exports specific formatting functions imported from other modules.

methods.name: export function formatMs(ms?: number | null): string { formatMs
methods.description: Converts a number of milliseconds to a locale-specific date string or returns 'n/a' if invalid.

methods.name: export function formatList(values?: Array<string | null | undefined>): string { formatList
methods.description: Formats an array of strings or null/undefined values into a comma-separated string or returns 'none' if empty.

methods.name: export function clampText(value: string, max = 120): string { clampText
methods.description: Truncates text to a maximum length (default 120), appending an ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: export function truncateText( truncateText
methods.description: Truncates text to a specified maximum length, returning an object with truncated text, a truncation flag, and total length.

methods.name: export function toNumber(value: string, fallback: number): number { toNumber
methods.description: Converts a string to a number, falling back to a provided fallback value if conversion fails.

methods.name: export function parseList(input: string): string[] { parseList
methods.description: Splits a string by commas or newlines into an array of trimmed strings, filtering out empty entries.

methods.name: export function stripThinkingTags(value: string): string { stripThinkingTags
methods.description: Removes assistant internal scaffolding or thinking tags from a string.

methods.name: export function formatCost(cost: number | null | undefined, fallback = "$0.00"): string { formatCost
methods.description: Formats a cost value as a dollar amount string, with special handling for null/undefined and small values.

methods.name: export function formatTokens(tokens: number | null | undefined, fallback = "0"): string { formatTokens
methods.description: Formats a token count into a human-readable string with units (k, M), with fallback.

methods.name: export function formatPercent(value: number | null | undefined, fallback = "—"): string { formatPercent
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage string, with fallback for null/undefined values.

calls: values.filter((v): v is string => Boolean(v && v.trim()))
